title: A birthday surprise
text:
Ewa's fortieth birthday was on a Saturday, but nobody in her family said anything about it in the morning. Her husband, Marek, went to work. Her children went to their grandmother's house. Ewa was sad. "They forgot," she thought.

In the afternoon her best friend, Kasia, called her. "Let's go shopping," she said. They went to the city centre and walked around the shops for three hours. Kasia bought Ewa a beautiful blue scarf. Then they had coffee and cake in a small café. Ewa felt a little better.

At seven o'clock Kasia drove her home. The house was dark and very quiet. Ewa opened the door and turned on the light. "SURPRISE!" shouted thirty people. Her family, her friends from work, her neighbours – everyone was there! There were balloons, flowers and a huge chocolate cake with forty candles.

Marek kissed her. "Did you really think we forgot?" he asked. Ewa laughed and cried at the same time. It was the best birthday of her life.
